structs.notes: Replay's LobbyData is the lobby's PartyData instance: g_lobbyData is the only LobbyData object, and every Replay reference to it (38 data/offset xrefs in [0x14C73ADE0, 0x14C7961A8), all listed by idb_query on xrefs) lands on a PartyData offset (session 0, partyMembers 2192, _pad185D0 99792, currentHost 310960, areWeHost 311112, inParty 311116, partyId 311052, partyName 311056, uiRoot 351945). The packet's claim 'no Replay code touches LobbyData' is wrong: Lobby_IsLocalInParty, Lobby_GetHostXuid, Lobby_GetPartyData, Lobby_Init and Lobby_IsInRunningLobby_0 touch it. The proposal for the coordinator: LobbyData { PartyData party; } with size 373704, which needs PartyData to be 373704 (A092/A108 agree). Lead for A092, not applied here: the dynamic initializer for PartyState_14C73AE40 constructs members at lobby offsets 96, 136, 140, 144, 2192, 99792, 310960, 361984, 362000 and 373312, which fit the PartyData layout.
